summary.text: Harvesttide is an ancient festival of Kessig, revived by the witches, meant to bring hope and restore the balance between light and darkness.

bio.text: The festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope, but more people go missing, and Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move.

status.text: The only event recorded for Harvesttide shows it meant to bring hope while more people go missing; the material records nothing further.
